speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with frequent nosebleeds, bleeding from your mouth or eyes, and tiny red spots on your skin. To understand what is causing this, I need to know more about your history. Have you or your parents noticed easy bruising anywhere else on your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP)

The clinical picture of frequent epistaxis, gum bleeding, and petechiae in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of ITP. Please confirm if the child has had any recent viral infections in the past month, and have you noticed any other abnormal bleeding or signs of anemia?
